newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Leading Spirit signs US$38 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Leading Spirit signs US$38 mln loan.

text.p: Leading Spirit (Holdings) Co said on Tuesday it had signed a US$38 million loan facility with nine banks.
The transferable loan facility was increased to US$38 million from US$36 million in syndication. It carries a maturity of 2.5 years and has an average life of 2.15 years.
It pays an interest margin of 150 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate. With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 177.9 basis points.

Arrangers of the facility are Bank of Communications Hong Kong, BNP Hong Kong, Bankers Trust Co Hong Kong$ DBS Bank Hong Kong, Industrial & Commercial Bank of China Singapore and Sumitomo Bank Hong Kong.
Proceeds of the loan will be used to finance joint venture factories in China as well as for general working capital, group chairman Wong Shi-Ling said.
Wong also announced that the company plans to establish an investment company dedicated to investing in quality industrial projects with reasonable returns. He did not provide details.
